title: A user without create and edit cannot drag or reassign work orders
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Ralph Edwards") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. A second user whose role has Work Orders view but not Work Orders create and edit (e.g. "Vera Viewonly"): Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create custom role (e.g. "WO View Only") with Work Orders view only > Save, then Settings > Staff > add "Vera Viewonly" with that role and an email, enrolled at this location.
  6. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  7. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
custom_steps:
1. In a second browser sign in as Vera Viewonly and pick the same location.
  2. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  3. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  4. Try to drag the card from Esther Howard's column into Ralph Edwards' column.
  5. Try to drag the card to a different position within Esther Howard's column.
  6. Hover the card and look for More actions and Reassign lead technician.
  7. Repeat steps 4 to 6 in Tech View.
  8. In your first browser (your own user) open the work order and read Lead Technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Vera Viewonly cannot drag the card to another technician or within the column; it stays where it was and the lead stays Esther Howard.
  • Vera Viewonly is not offered Reassign lead technician (no More actions button, or the action is missing or disabled).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-N1, read 8 Oct 2026. PRD §4 Key decision "Permissions". Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): more-actions button hidden without the assign permission; a refused drag shows "You don’t have permission to assign technicians". Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N1: “Require Work Orders create and edit permission to drag work orders or access Reassign lead technician.”
